question: What is the irreducible cost structure of a custom signage job, and why does it tend toward winner-take-most pricing dynamics?
summary: Fixed costs dominate custom signage jobs; buyer switching costs and incumbent learning-curve advantage create winner-take-most consolidation at the premium commercial tier. Corpus treats pricing operationally (T&M markup) but never frames it as a market-structure question. Value-based pricing on economic outcome (10% sales lift anchor) is present in corpus data but never operationalized.
